title: Herbs for Winter

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: In summer we dried herbs from the garden: mint for tea, sage for soup, and bay for the stew. Now they've all got jumbled!

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Each herb has a leaf of a different shape. Would you sort them into their jars?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put each leaf in the jar with the same shape on it.
steps.hint: Look at the shape of the leaf's edge.

feedback.mismatch: Look again at that leaf's shape.
feedback.all_good: Every herb in its jar. Mint tea tonight!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Now we'll have tea and soup and stew all winter long, with a taste of summer in every spoonful.

journal_line: I sorted dried herbs into their jars at the monastery.
